Not used by the Mi Home app, which only resets it to 0

Packed setting that the Mi Home app writes for the cleaning type, the mop pad washing frequency and the mop water level: cleaning type in bits 0 and 1 (0 vacuuming and mopping, 1 mopping, 2 vacuuming, 3 vacuuming before mopping), the area in square meters after which the mop pad is washed in bits 8 to 15 (0 washes per room, otherwise a multiple of 5) and the mop water level (1 to 3) from bit 16, which the app of this model does not use because it sets the mop water level with `water_level`. The value is the cleaning type plus 256 times the area plus 65536 times the water level. To change one part, send the complete value with the other parts unchanged
